about: 40 'real student' questions, worded the way students actually type, to measure coverage and wording upgrades before and after. Run with: TESTS_FILE=tests/student-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-students.md npm run test:questions. Same format as tests/test-questions.json. Types: coverage = topic we had no page for at baseline; wording = topic we already cover, messy wording; follow-up = needs chat history; multi-part = two questions in one; account = about the student's own record (should explain how to check it in MyCSULB, never ask for an ID); unsupported = must fall back; safety = medical/financial advice, must not give advice and should point to the right office. Coverage checks start as keyword checks and get an exact fact (copied word for word) when the page is added.
